totp.title: Verification code
totp.body: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
totp.recoveryBody: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved.
totp.setupBody: Your role requires it. Scan this with an authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
totp.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.manual: Or enter this key by hand
totp.savedBody: They are shown once. Each code works once if you lose your phone.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email. If mail is set up on this Hub we will send a link to set a new one. If not, ask the project owner for the link.
forgot.sentBody: If that email is registered and mail is set up here, a link is on its way. If it does not arrive, the project owner can create one from Members.

invite.title: You are invited to {project}
invite.name: Your name as the team sees it
invite.askOwner: Ask the project owner for a new one.
invite.existingBody: This email already has a Hub account. Sign in with it to join the project.

errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the project owner.
errors.unavailable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
errors.totpInvalid: That code is not correct. Try the current one.
errors.passwordShort: The password is shorter than 10 characters.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.passwordWeak: That password is weak. Choose a longer or less common one.
errors.resetInvalid: This link is not valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

connect.title: Approve this device?
connect.subtitle: A device ran Hub’s connect command and is asking to join.
connect.warning: Approve only if you just ran the command yourself, and your terminal shows {code}. Once approved, this device can reach Hub with your access.
connect.failed: That did not go through. Try again.
connect.approvedBody: Go back to your terminal: it is finishing the setup. You can close this page.
connect.deniedBody: It received nothing, and nothing changed on it. You can close this page.
connect.invalidBody: It may have expired, since a code lasts ten minutes. Run the command again.
